Kill [[Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].
* *BONUS* Kill Mobrin in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 1,250 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
Head east from [[Gadd's Encampment]]. He [[patrol]]s in a small area just to the north west of [[Bloodstone Caves]]. He is often accompanied by a patrol of raptors.
[[Earthbind]], [[Weakness]], [["Can't Touch This!"]] and/or [[Pain Inverter]] are particularly effective.
